item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Branch Library: The summary now says the library opened July 8, 2006 (SFPL's history page) instead of leading with the Assessor's 2005 year built. The Phil'z Coffee entry no longer gives an opening date: 2007-04-01 is a business-registration date in DataSF, and Phil'z's own locations page only shows the 201 Berry St store operating now. The record's notes no longer call the Assessor's 201 Berry St address stale, since Phil'z is registered at that address, and now cite the DataSF Assessor roll and parcels.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Branch Library: The Mission Bay Branch Library's completion date corrected. The earlier entry gave a rough 2005 year from a weak guess based on DataSF Assessor data. SFPL's own "Facts & Figures" PDF, already checked directly and confirmed during earlier research verification, states the actual grand opening was July 8, 2006, and adds a Dec 10, 2003 groundbreaking as a real earlier stage. The confirmed date had not been applied to the record at the time; this was caught on a later re-check.
item.description: The Mission Bay Branch Library's completion date corrected. The earlier entry gave a rough 2005 year from a weak guess based on DataSF Assessor data. SFPL's own "Facts & Figures" PDF, already checked directly and confirmed during earlier research verification, states the actual grand opening was July 8, 2006, and adds a Dec 10, 2003 groundbreaking as a real earlier stage. The confirmed date had not been applied to the record at the time; this was caught on a later re-check. Source: San Francisco Public Library, "Mission Bay Branch Library Facts & Figures" (sfpl.org/archive/blip/missionbayfaq.pdf).

item.title: Added · Mission Bay Branch Library: Mission Bay Branch Library added as an active Assessor-parcel record (blklot 8708110, 960 4th St, built 2005). The Assessor tax roll's own property location for this parcel reads '201 BERRY ST', a different street address from the library's 4th St address; Phil'z Coffee is registered at that same 201 Berry St address in DataSF Registered Business Locations, so it is a live address, not a stale one.
